_about: Benchmark sets by job type. Compare new work ONLY within the matching set (award winners are the wrong model for reading, care or tools: see docs/design-catalogue). Add sites with a one-line why. Re-capture quarterly: node scripts/capture-references.mjs

showcase-story.use_for: scroll stories, launches, portfolios, brand worlds (spectacle, motion, 3D). Weak on accessibility: take craft, not structure.

sites.why: Awwwards SOTY 2025; playable world, handmade illustrative style
Awwwards SOTY 2024; WebGL UI, procedural ice, particle footer
studio of SOTY 2023; buttery motion, 3D storytelling
SOTY 2023; per-product universes, commerce under play

reading-first.use_for: long-form reading, essays, books: measure, rhythm, restraint, wayfinding. THE benchmark for html books.

sites.why: reading comfort, measure, progress, restrained imagery
science long-reads with figures and illustration
book as designed object; per-book identity; cover moment
explanatory hand-drawn figures, huge single-page arguments
best-in-class book typography conventions, public-domain books
a typography book as a website; plain, perfect rhythm
sidenotes, link popups, extreme reading features (study, do not copy density)
explorable explanations embedded in a long read

tools-product.use_for: lookup tools, apps, instruments (the Pattern Decoder): density, speed, navigation, command palette.

sites.why: dark product craft, thin borders, tight grids
animated gradient hero, precise layout, docs excellence

care-public-service.use_for: safety, care, crisis, public-service content: clarity, calm, quick exit, plain language. Overrides spectacle.

sites.why: accessibility benchmark, plain language, one thing per page
tested components, patterns incl. 'exit this page' (study)
domestic-violence service: quick exit, neutral calm
abuse support: quick exit pattern, discreet design
